# MalawiHub

MalawiHub is a student-focused learning and utility hub built for learners in Malawi and accessible worldwide.

## Public website
https://malawihub.pages.dev/

## Main features
- GPA Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/gpa/
- Grade Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/grade/
- Study Timetable: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/timetable/
- Assignment Cover: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/assignment/
- Smart Writer: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/smart-writer/
- Chemistry Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/chemistry/
- Percentage Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/percentage/
- Currency Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/currency/
- Profit Calculator: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tools/profit/
- Study Resources: https://malawihub.pages.dev/resources/
- Subject areas: Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Biology and Education
- Past Papers: https://malawihub.pages.dev/papers/
- Tutorial: https://malawihub.pages.dev/tutorial/

## Audience
Students, learners, teachers and everyday users looking for practical study tools, calculators and learning resources.

## Focus
Malawi is the primary focus, while the public tools and resources are available to learners and users everywhere.

## Discovery
Sitemap: https://malawihub.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://malawihub.pages.dev/robots.txt
